commands.name: search-materials
commands.summary: Full-text and metadata search over digitized materials. Returns matching pages (bindings) with OCR highlights.

commands.name: search-articles
commands.summary: Search component parts (articles or sections within issues) by keyword. Returns article titles with their binding and page.

commands.name: get-binding
commands.summary: Get details of one issue or volume (binding): title, date, ISSN, page list with image URLs, PDF link and citation info.

commands.name: get-page-ocr
commands.summary: Get the OCR text blocks of one page of a binding.

commands.name: get-ocr-hits
commands.summary: Get the positions (bounding boxes) of a search term on one page of a binding.

commands.name: list-page-component-parts
commands.summary: List the component parts (articles or sections) that appear on a given page of a binding.

commands.name: get-title-info
commands.summary: Get descriptive metadata for a serial title by ISSN: publishing period, places, supplements, political orientation, predecessors and successors.

commands.name: list-title-years
commands.summary: List the years for which a serial title (newspaper or journal) has digitized issues.

commands.name: list-title-issues
commands.summary: List all digitized issues of a serial title for one year, with binding ids and dates.

commands.name: list-serial-publications
commands.summary: List all digitized newspaper and journal titles, with ISSN or id, years, languages, places and coverage. The response is large.

commands.name: search-clippings
commands.summary: Search user-made clippings (cut-out articles with category, subject and keywords) by keyword and date.

commands.name: get-clipping
commands.summary: Get one user clipping (article) by id: title, text, keywords and source binding.

commands.name: list-clipping-categories
commands.summary: List clipping categories and subjects (ids and Finnish names) used to classify clippings.

commands.name: search-clipping-keywords
commands.summary: Look up keywords that users have assigned to clippings.

commands.name: search-filter-values
commands.summary: Look up values for search filters: titles, collections, publishers, publishing places, tags or authors.

commands.name: get-public-access-cutoffs
commands.summary: Show, per material type, the date up to which material is freely viewable. Newer material is restricted for anonymous users.

commands.name: list-collections
commands.summary: List the collection tree (collection ids and names, nested by category).

commands.name: get-collection
commands.summary: Get a collection's name, HTML description and material types.

commands.name: harvest-oai-records
commands.summary: Harvest Dublin Core metadata records for a collection through the public OAI-PMH interface (ListRecords).

dropped.name: get-clipping-comments
dropped.reason: empty list: the example args returned nothing or the selector/resultPath is wrong
